title: What I took from your answers

cards.title: Runs, maze and look
cards.text: Your answers to the first pack, as I understood them. Mark anything I've got wrong.
cards.why: These now steer the build. Better to catch a misreading here than in code.

parts.title: Endless
parts.text: No exit. The run ends when you die. How shards are kept on death is open again.

parts.title: Camps and waves
parts.text: Camps of different enemy tiers spread through the maze. About every minute a wave of one tier comes from every side.

parts.title: Chests random
parts.text: Chests anywhere, not better in deeper dead ends. Maybe better as time goes on.

parts.title: 2×2 enemies
parts.text: Most enemies the same size as you, and they don't overlap.

parts.title: Screen
parts.text: No minimap. Rounds as a ring round the fire stick. Summon on a cooldown. Dash deletes bullets you dash through.

parts.title: Look
parts.text: Flat and solid. You white, Poison purple, Uncommon green as a new rarity. Enemies need more colours than red and magenta.

cards.title: Spells, as I read them
cards.text: Your notes on how modules combine. Mark anything I've got wrong before I design the formula.
cards.why: The next design deck turns this into the rules for what combines with what.

parts.title: Generic terms
parts.text: A few shared terms that mean something on anything: Capacity is more bullets on a gun, more bounces on Bounce, longer on Burn. Speed is fire rate, faster after bounce, faster ticks.

parts.title: Events, not fallbacks
parts.text: A module that has nothing to do on a shape isn't allowed there, instead of getting a weak stand-in. Modules hook into events (hit, bounce, end...) and only combine where an event fits.

parts.title: Augments
parts.text: Change how one module works by hooking its event: Bounce that retargets, speeds up each bounce but shrinks, or explodes, splits or spawns on each bounce. Often with a drawback.

parts.title: Depth by count
parts.text: No fixed nesting limit: how deep a spell goes is capped by how many modules it holds. Link can feed a Split.

parts.title: Player upgrades
parts.text: Upgrades for you too: health, speed, cooldowns, resistances, and reactive ones (3 spawns when you're badly hurt).

parts.title: More casts
parts.text: More than three casts is allowed. The Summon starts as a plain Spawn.

parts.title: My call: elites
parts.text: You weren't sure if elites drop modules. I've said yes, they drop the one they carry, so it's one system both ways.
